channel.title: Leonida Tours blog
channel.description: Guides to the real Miami, the Everglades and the Florida Keys from the people who run the tours.

item.title: GTA 6 Release Date: November 19, 2026 and What to Do in Miami
item.description: The date is locked: November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here is the confirmed timeline, what changed twice on the way, and the smartest way to spend launch week if you are already in South Florida.

item.title: GTA 6 Locations in Real Life: 24 Miami and Florida Places
item.description: Twenty-four places, from the Ocean View Hotel to the Everglades airboat, each matched to a real address with coordinates and a confidence rating. This is the list to take with you.

item.title: Is GTA 6 Set in Miami? Leonida, Vice City and the Real Florida
item.description: Partly. Vice City is Miami, but Leonida is a whole invented state, and the differences matter for anyone planning a trip or writing about the game.

item.title: GTA 6 Map: The Six Regions of Leonida and Where They Are
item.description: Six official regions, one fictional state, and a surprising amount of real Florida underneath. Here is the official copy for each region next to the geography it borrows from.

item.title: GTA 6 Trailers, Timestamped to the Real Miami Locations
item.description: Four official videos, and every one of them contains at least one frame you can stand in. Here is where each real location appears, to the second.

item.title: Grassrivers Is the Everglades: Seeing GTA 6's Swamp for Real
item.description: There is no serious alternative: the game's wetland region is the Everglades. Here is the official copy, the geography, and what the airboat ride is actually like.

item.title: Leonida Keys Is the Florida Keys: The Seven Mile Bridge
item.description: The game's southern archipelago is the Florida Keys, down to the Seven Mile Bridge and the bar where the boat owners keep their slips. Here is the real route, and how long it really takes.

item.title: Best Things to Do in Miami Beach in One Day (2026)
item.description: One day, no filler. The order matters: the beach at 7am, the murals at 11, the water at sunset and the neon after 8. Here is the timing that makes it work.

item.title: Miami Sunset Cruise Guide: Biscayne Bay and Millionaire's Row
item.description: The boat leaves at 6:30pm for a reason. Here is the route, where the light actually hits the skyline, and what to bring so you are not cold on the water.

item.title: Everglades Airboat Tours from Miami: Timings and What You'll See
item.description: Four hours door to door, thirty minutes on the water, and a completely different landscape from anything else in Florida. Here is the practical version before you book.

item.title: Miami in 3 Days: A Locals' Itinerary
item.description: Three days, organised so that no day has more than one big anchor. The bay and the strip on day one, the murals and the Cuban food on day two, the wild part on day three.

item.title: Miami Launch Week: What to Do in South Florida from November 19
item.description: One week in the most popular city in America. What actually changes, which days are worth booking, and the three things that sell out first.
